title: Go Bag Essentials
description: Packing lists for primary and secondary adults, teens, children, infants, older relatives, dogs, and cats, matched to the Ready.gov kit. Explains how to handle the 1-gallon-per-day water standard when you can't carry it all, plus weight rules of thumb, choosing a bag, storage, and maintenance.
shortDescription: A carryable bag for each family member, from adults and kids to pets
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
